name: nsams
description: Offline-first multi-page PWA for national school-attendance tracking (school / directorate / ministry / teacher). CI tooling lives here; the app itself is the static HTML/JS in each role folder.

scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:html && npm run check:versions && npm run check:manifest
scripts.check:html: html-validate index.html school/index.html directorate/index.html directorate/school.html ministry/index.html teacher/index.html parent/index.html admin/index.html
